video_title: Celtics vs. Rockets: GAME OF THE NIGHT 11/2/26

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert debate the Celtics versus Rockets matchup
quotes.excerpt: Unless Payton Pritchard comes to play, I can't see them beating Houston.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I think I got Houston, man. I was just watching the Celtics against the Magic and though Jayson Tatum is able to pull it out of a hat here and there, unless Payton Pritchard comes to play, I can't see them beating Houston. They just need more firepower.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: It is that Thompson twin, man. As much as I want to give it to the rest of the squad, because everybody is hooping, especially their starting five, man, I'm in.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert discuss the Thompson twins' development
quotes.excerpt: Ever since they got paid, them niggas have been playing one-on-one because they look different.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He is what you call it, his whole year with having the ball in his hands really helped his confidence. I like it though, because he didn't lose no fire on D. I told you, him and his brother been playing one-on-one in the back. Ever since they got paid, them niggas have been playing one-on-one because they look different. They look like they back to the essentials. They got the fear of God essential pack on right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and it is just from, I mean, especially it is the playmaking. The playmaking, the playmaking. But his brother, Amen has been making some plays. I like the playmaking. I mean, I keep having to keep mentioning both of them, but especially with Amen just because he, we needed that from him. That was our biggest knock against him in the playoffs. We need shit from him.
